grader.scenario: Erroneous £240 early termination charge billed after customer moved to a rural postcode where S-Net has no network coverage
grader.notes: Excellent 100.0 call with natural STT disfluencies. Zara verifies address and security question within 2 minutes ([00:52]-[01:21]), empathizes warmly ([00:23]-[00:52]), paraphrases clearly ([01:21]), probes into the home-move reference, council tax proof, and router return ([01:52]-[04:45]), and takes complete personal ownership ([05:54]-[09:55]) rather than transferring Nafisa to retentions—verifying the non-serviceable postcode LL57 4BQ and posting credit note CN-8830419 (-£240.00) which Nafisa verifies live in her S-Net app ([10:57]-[11:40]).

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Greeting at [00:00] ('thank you for calling S-Net') and closing with survey check at [15:53] ('Thank you for choosing S-Net').

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Single managed 62s hold between [06:59] ('Please bear with me for a moment while I query the wholesale postcode database...') and [08:25] ('Thank you so much for holding, Nafisa!').

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: At [00:52] (within 2 minutes) Agent verified previous billing address and security question ('first primary school'), confirmed at [01:10]-[01:21].

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent used 'Nafisa' warmly throughout the call ([00:23], [00:52], [01:21], [05:54], [08:25], [15:53]).

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: At [00:23] and [00:52] Agent apologized sincerely and validated the shock and stress of receiving an erroneous £240 charge right after moving home.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: At [01:21] Agent paraphrased: 'after moving from Leeds to a rural area where S-Net has no network coverage, your closed account was erroneously charged a two hundred and forty pound early termination fee.'

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent accurately recalled LL57 4BQ, Flat 4 19 Clarendon Road, HM-774120, and Royal Mail tracking RM449012883GB throughout the call ([09:05], [12:18], [12:38]).

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: At [05:54]-[09:55] Agent refused to transfer the customer to retentions/home-move, checked the Ofcom wholesale coverage database for LL57 4BQ herself, recoded the cease order, cancelled the Direct Debit collection, and applied the £240 credit note CN-8830419.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Warm, personable rapport throughout, including friendly chat about unpacking kitchen boxes and mountain views in North Wales ([02:17]-[02:37], [14:06]-[14:23]).

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent probed the new rural postcode ([01:52]), home-move reference ([02:37]), completion date ([03:03]), council tax proof of residency ([03:29]), and Hub 5 Royal Mail return tracking ([04:20]).

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: At [10:44]-[11:40] and [14:38], Nafisa refreshed her S-Net app and downloaded the revised final statement PDF live on the call, confirming Credit Note CN-8830419 (-£240.00) and a £0.00 settled balance.
